description:
Direction and strength of change in an indicator over a period.

``significant`` is the field that matters. A slope without a significance test invites
the reader to see a trend in noise, which is the quantitative failure mode lesson 2
exists to prevent.

first.description: Fitted value at the start of the period.
first.title: First

last.description: Fitted value at the end of the period.
last.title: Last

significant.description: True when p < 0.05 and at least 4 observations contributed.
significant.title: Significant

slope_per_month.description: Ordinary least squares slope, units per month.
slope_per_month.title: Slope Per Month

title: Trend
